name: io.github.TMCHALK/sftunes
description: Hand-made human mixtapes with liner notes. Paid via x402: list $0.05, one tape $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: about_sftunes
tools.description: What SFtunes is and how x402 payment works. Free.

tools.name: list_tapes
tools.description: Index of all public SFtunes items: mixtapes (type 'tape') and public profiles' Top 10 lists (type 'top_ten'), each with id, title, tapemaker handle, track_count. Costs $0.05 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_tape
tools.description: One public SFtunes item by tape_id: a tape uuid, or top10-<handle> for a person's Top 10 + Side B. Ordered tracks with artist/title/liner note and canonical Spotify/Apple/YouTube links. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402; the proceeds keep SFtunes free.
